title: Clearwater Beach Bus Express
includes: Express Round Trip Transportation from Kissimmee -Celebration, Charlies Steakhouse
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Dress code is beach wear, its a day at the beach so dress accordingly
Please advise Gray Line in advance if wheelchair lift vehicles are required as not all vehicles have them.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is a day for fun in the sun on the Gulf Coast of Mexico at Clearwater Beach. You can stroll along the pier, take in some sun, or go on one of many boat rides! 

Our express service is direct transportation from the Charlies Steakhouse, Kissimmee / Celebration area.

Clearwater Beach has been rated the Number 1 Beach in the USA on TripAdvisor. Gray Line Orlando offers you easy to use transportation - so sit back and relax, let our professional drivers get you to the beach.

Upon arrival at the beach you have the day to enjoy at your leisure. Lay on the sand, swim in the Gulf of Mexico, walk down the pier and do some shopping in the beachside stores. 

The perfect way to get away from the theme park lines in Orlando, and take a day to relax and unwind. Don't miss out on a visit to Clearwater Beach.
